title: The miracles of Allah’s messengers
intro: A mu‘jizah is a supernatural sign from Allah that proved a messenger was truly sent by Him.

learn.html: A mu‘jizah (miracle) is a supernatural event, the work of Allah, which Allah’s messengers had as proof of their prophethood. Allah gave each messenger miracles from the field his people knew best.

learn.title: Musa (AS) and the magicians
learn.html: When Musa (AS) lived in Egypt, magic was widespread. By Allah’s will, Musa’s staff turned into a snake and swallowed the snakes (ropes) of the magicians. The magicians saw that this was a true miracle and not deception and magic like their own ropes. They believed in Allah and accepted Musa (AS) and his brother Harun (AS) as Allah’s prophets. Other miracles of Musa (AS): the parting of the sea, and his hand shining white when he took it out from under his arm.

learn.title: ‘Isa (AS) and medicine
learn.html: In the time of ‘Isa (AS) medicine was highly developed, and Allah gave him miracles from that field. He healed a person born blind and a person with leprosy, and brought the dead back to life – all by Allah’s permission. He also spoke as a baby in the cradle, and blew into a bird made of clay and it came to life.

learn.title: Muhammad (SAW) and the Qur’an
learn.html: The people of Muhammad’s time had reached the highest level of eloquence, speech and poetry. But even they fell silent and powerless when they heard the Qur’an – his greatest miracle. Some tried in vain to make something like it, but in the end they had to admit that the Qur’an is not human work but the speech of Allah.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah says: if you are in doubt about what We have sent down to Our servant, then bring one surah like it, and call your helpers besides Allah, if you are truthful. And if you do not – and you never will – then fear the Fire whose fuel is people and stones. (Qur’an, Al-Baqarah 2:23–24)

The Qur’an’s style, expression, content, meaning and melody amazed both those who accepted it and those who rejected it. Every generation until the Day of Judgement will remain powerless before the Qur’an’s way of speaking.

learn.text: Miracles of other messengers in the Qur’an

items.label: Nuh (AS) – built a ship on dry land before the flood that drowned the unbelievers
Salih (AS) – the she-camel that came out of a rock, because his people asked for proof
Ibrahim (AS) – thrown into a great fire that became cool and safe for him
Ibrahim (AS) – four birds placed on four hills came back to life and flew to him when he called
Yunus (AS) – swallowed by a great fish, kept safe and brought to the seashore

learn.html: The miracles of the messengers before Muhammad (SAW) could be seen, so only those who saw them could be convinced by them. The miracles of Muhammad (SAW) are of both kinds. Miracles of the mind last for ever – future generations can come to know them until the Day of Judgement.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Allah sent the people of Salih (AS) a miracle: a she-camel that came out of a rock. The greatest and lasting miracle is the Qur’an.
